description: This file defines an enumeration for the dividend status types associated with share accounts in the Fineract project. It specifies statuses such as invalid, initiated, and posted, along with methods to convert integer codes into enum instances and retrieve associated values and codes.

classes.name: ShareAccountDividendStatusType
classes.description: An enum representing the various possible dividend statuses for share accounts, including invalid, initiated, and posted statuses. It provides methods to convert from integer codes and retrieve status details.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Converts an integer to the corresponding ShareAccountDividendStatusType enum value. Defaults to INVALID if the input code does not match known statuses.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the integer value associated with the dividend status.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the string code associated with the dividend status.
